content: {"votes":[{"direction":"UNKNOWN","importance":7,"rationale":"The UK's future position in the EU ETS is uncertain due to ongoing negotiations and political uncertainty, making it difficult to predict whether it will remain or exit the system."},{"direction":"NO","importance":6,"rationale":"The UK has already left the EU ETS and is developing its own carbon market; remaining in the EU ETS is unlikely given its sovereignty and policy divergence from EU climate goals."},{"direction":"YES","importance":5,"rationale":"There is potential for the UK to rejoin or align with the EU ETS under future agreements, especially if climate policy convergence or regulatory cooperation emerges."}]}
